user.title: Connect a device
user.description: Open the device in IntelliThings, click the Home Assistant button in the header and generate an access token.

data_description.base_url: HTTPS is required unless the server is on your local network.
data_description.token: The access token generated from the device's detail page. It authenticates this one device.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {name} is no longer valid. Generate a new one from the device's detail page and paste it here.

data_description.token: The new access token for your device.

error.invalid_url: That server URL is not usable. Use a full http:// or https:// address — HTTPS is required unless the server is on your local network.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check the URL and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. It may have been revoked, or the Home Assistant plugin may be switched off for your organisation.
error.unknown: The server responded, but did not describe a device.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
